end.summary:
Practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
5 attempts made; 2 were unaided correct.
Discussed muscle-cell diagram features: outline, nucleus, fibres, and labels.
Reviewed amoeba as a single-celled organism; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Yash practised the levels of organisation and worked through the parts of a muscle-cell diagram. They identified that tissues are made of cells and that amoeba is a single cell; the order of tissue and organ system remained mixed up during the lesson. At home, use arrows to practise the sequence: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism, and ask Yash to label a simple muscle-cell sketch.
